method: Use break_case_exec.mk_case_list semantics for the top-level left facet and evaluate the exact delta_x times -1 polynomial on that first independent leaf. The benchmark first repeats its public-domain companion and then checks the first-leaf theorem. All reflected computation theorems are assumption-free; the soundness theorem retains exactly the six scalar interval assumptions.
conclusion: The exact first partition leaf remains easy for proof-producing reflection, but raw interval dependency loss still gives an interval spanning zero. The modest narrowing relative to the public domain does not change the integration plan: the reflected checker must consume a Taylor model, including its first- and second-derivative enclosures, rather than only reevaluate the source polynomial on a box.
